We can do two 30-minute slots and will come with a short prioritized agenda so the legal/commerce questions get surfaced immediately:
- Tue 3/28 11:00–11:30 PDT (preferred)
- Wed 3/29 09:00–09:30 PDT (alternate)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 11:05:00 -0700 (PDT)
Subject: internal: Everest MSA redlines — quick read

Mina / Marissa — I reviewed Everest_MSA_Redlines_v3.pdf. Top items to prioritize during the 30-min triage:
1) Indemnity carveouts they added (we should propose language parity with standard cloud customers)
2) Data retention and deletion timeline — they want 180 days for backups, we typically do 90
3) Audit scope — they're asking for annual on-site audits (we should offer remote with logs unless enterprise SOW)

If 3/28 11:00 PST works for both, I'll prepare a 1-page redline summary and mark the clause lines. Also suggest we timebox to 25 minutes for discussion + 5 minutes for next steps so we leave with a mutual action plan.

-Hannah
Legal Counsel | Redwood Inference
